feedback: Pre-race review. Nothing has raced for this candidate, so this states no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: five sensors match five weights, x-positions are within ±0.08 m, and base_speed 1.2 is inside its 0.05 to 2 range. It changes one group from the best raced design (iteration 5, score 41.1832): controller.base_speed from 1.4 to 1.2, with geometry, kp 2.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.2 and line_loss last_direction unchanged. The evidence supports this test. Iteration 5 lowered oval steering_oscillation only to 0.111 (iteration 3 measured 0.113), so the oscillation is not a gain problem. Iterations 3 to 5 moved kp, ki and kd and changed the score by under 0.5 in total. Every run on every track still ends off_track with max_error at 0.0609 to 0.0629 m and line_loss_events 0. That pattern fits a speed-driven outward drift or a fixed bias, and lower speed is the one lever not yet tried. The race is needed to see it. Do not treat the rationale's expected progress gains as measured. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. (a) If s-bend and slalom progress rise above 0.041 and 0.035 and max_error falls below 0.061, speed-driven slip was the limit. Keep base_speed at 1.2 and consider a modest increase (about 1.3) to recover completion time. (b) If max_error stays at about 0.061 with unchanged progress on all tracks, the error is a sensor or motor-mismatch bias. Next, widen the outer sensors to x = ±0.07 with outer weights kept at ±1.5 and check noise_robustness. (c) If progress falls, return base_speed to 1.4, since iteration 5 is the best raced design. Change one group of fields per revision.
requested_changes: After the race, if s-bend and slalom progress rise above iteration 5's 0.0409 and 0.035 and max_error falls below 0.061, keep controller.base_speed at 1.2 and test about 1.3 next, with kp 2.5, ki 0.5 and kd 0.2 unchanged, to recover completion time.

If max_error stays at about 0.061 on every track with unchanged progress, set geometry.sensor_positions outer x to ±0.07 (within the ±0.08 limit) with outer sensor_weights kept at ±1.5 and inner weights at ±0.75, citing iterations 2 and 5 where the ±0.06 span removed line loss but max_error stayed pinned.
If progress falls below iteration 5's 0.0409 (s-bend) or 0.035 (slalom), set controller.base_speed back to 1.4, since iteration 5 is the best raced design at 41.1832.
